data.name: Arwaah
data.gender_notes: Arwaah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'r-w-w', meaning 'to soothe or calm'. Derived from the word 'ar-ruwa' which means 'comforting' or 'soothing'. The name Arwaah carries the meaning “Gentle, Soothing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Arwaah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, soothing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with a calming and nurturing presence.
data.etymology: Arwaah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Soothing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arwaah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
